text: The year 2100. In an effort to combat overpopulation, the postmortem social network "Anvil" is released. A fusion of both Japanese and Belgian comics inspirations and sensibilities, such as Ghost in the Shell, Akira or Peeters & Schuiten's work. "Anvil" invites us on a journey through the eyes of a young woman in her final moments on earth.

title: The Scarlet King's manifesto
text:
Existence is truth. Truth is a lie. Lies are pain. And this pain is like a gnat that is festering within your ear and no matter the effort you cannot be rid of it. This pain leads to madness and madness leads to evil. I seek the destruction of all to rid myself of that madness. And no one will stand in the way of my longing for peace from this noise.

~ The Scarlet King, SCP Universe

The pale starlings colony eats into the human head and nests in that place. 'Fear not' is not really an appropriate way to cope with them. They are dangerous, don't let their magnificent appearance fool you.

A.Shipwright @ShipwrightA
